title: United States, cold winters (Northeast / Midwest)
description: Snow, freezing pipes, winter tires. The original default set.

tasks.name: Flu shots
tasks.notes: Usually Sept-Oct. Book ahead; pharmacies carry vaccine from late Aug.

tasks.name: Lawn: Step 1 (crabgrass preventer + feed)
tasks.notes: Early spring, when soil is ~55F / forsythia in bloom (late April in the Northeast). Apply before crabgrass germinates.

tasks.name: Lawn: Step 2 (weed control + feed)
tasks.notes: About 6-8 weeks after Step 1. Do not apply in heat above ~85F or drought.

tasks.name: Lawn: Step 3 (summer feed, grub/insect protection)
tasks.notes: About 6-8 weeks after Step 2. Water in; avoid hot, dry days.

tasks.name: Lawn: overseed bare spots
tasks.notes: Best time to seed cool-season grass in the Northeast: late Aug through September.

tasks.name: Lawn: Step 4 (fall winterizer)
tasks.notes: Most important feeding of the year. Apply Oct to early Nov, before the ground freezes.

tasks.name: Furnace/boiler service + new filter
tasks.notes: Have the heating system serviced before the first cold snap; replace filters.

tasks.name: Chimney / fireplace inspection
tasks.notes: Only if you use a fireplace or wood stove.

tasks.name: Drain outdoor hoses, shut off exterior spigots, winterize sprinklers
tasks.notes: Before the first hard freeze (usually mid-late Oct).

tasks.name: Snow blower tune-up + fuel stabilizer
tasks.notes: Start it, check shear pins/belts/spark plug, fresh fuel. Service shops get busy after the first storm.

tasks.name: Car winter prep: battery test, wipers, washer fluid, antifreeze
tasks.notes: Battery, wipers, washer fluid, coolant, tire tread.

tasks.name: Switch to winter tires
tasks.notes: Rule of thumb: when daily highs stay below ~45F. Book tire shop slots early.

tasks.name: Smoke + CO detector batteries/test
tasks.notes: Change batteries when the clocks go back.

tasks.name: Clean gutters after leaf fall
tasks.notes: Prevents ice dams on the roof edge.

tasks.name: Stock ice melt, shovels, roof rake
tasks.notes: Stores run low after the first storm.

tasks.name: Generator test / emergency kit (flashlights, power banks, water)
tasks.notes: Winter storms can cause multi-day outages.

tasks.name: Check pipes / insulation / heat tape on exposed lines
Car winter emergency kit (blanket, scraper, jumper cables, shovel)
Smoke + CO detector test (spring)
tasks.notes: Test when the clocks go forward.
